purpose: BA-000-T3 evidence. Each entry MUST be rejected by the schema it names.
why: Pinning a discriminator and its per-variant required set proves the contract is SHAPED to reject bad payloads; it does not prove rejection happens. These payloads are fed to a JSON Schema evaluator and the check fails if any of them validates.

cases.name: item scope without its target
cases.why: scope ITEM carries targetItemId. Dropping it must not fall through to another variant.

cases.name: item scope wearing the day target
cases.why: Per-scope targets are not interchangeable; a DAY field under ITEM must not validate.

cases.name: apply decision without the revision pair
cases.why: APPLY is the decision that moves the trip, so it must name both sides of the move.

cases.name: revert decision without the decision it reverts
cases.why: REVERT undoes one named APPLY; without revertedDecisionId it names nothing.

cases.name: keep decision carrying a revision pair it cannot have
cases.why: KEEP changes nothing, so there is no before/after to report. additionalProperties is false.
